asset_set: Questionnaire Q15 option 1 — Managing e-commerce store

subject.scene_narrative: A young woman strides forward carrying a small parcel box while checking a phone showing a coral shopping-cart icon and a yellow order badge — full-body flat vector language matching the approved Q1 references.
subject.hero_prop: phone displaying a glowing coral shopping-cart icon and yellow order badge
supporting_props: small parcel box with coral tape
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey circles behind figure — no room interior

composition.layout: figure left-of-center, hero prop right, balanced like 1.1.png

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background.
